findings.issue: No test runner, no test script, and no tests anywhere in the app; the acceptance suite is the only guard.
findings.suggestion: Add vitest (or @solidjs/testing-library equivalents) with unit tests for app/src/lib/server/model.ts and app/src/lib/format.ts, which are pure-ish and cheap to cover.

findings.issue: homeData combines search/generation/type filtering, species ordering and page clamping; a regression here silently changes every list page and the count.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test filtersFrom/searchFor/homeData against a small fixture list: filters intersection, empty result page clamp, page beyond totalPages, count vs page slice.

findings.issue: Debounced search input, pushedQuery guard effect and URL param omission rules are hand-rolled; back/forward navigation and page-reset-on-filter-change are untested behaviours.
findings.suggestion: Add component tests asserting: typing updates the URL after debounce, changing type/generation resets page to 1, and omitted defaults produce '/' not '/?page=1'.

findings.issue: Sort comparator implements missing-values-last in both directions plus a label tie-break; a refactor can easily flip null ordering or break the ascending-first toggle and aria-sort contract.
findings.suggestion: Extract the comparator and unit-test it: nulls last ascending and descending, numeric vs string columns, second-click flips direction.

findings.issue: cardsFor enforces the alternate-form exclusion and one-card-per-species invariant used by four pages; the only guard is the external live-data-overlay test.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test with mixed species/form references (id > 10000, duplicate species, out-of-list ids) asserting dedupe, ordering by dex number and species-name resolution.

findings.issue: pokemonMovesData's method ordering (methodRank with Infinity sentinel), default-game selection (highest order) and level-then-name default sort are untested.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test methodRank ordering including unknown methods, and the default selection when ?game= is absent or invalid.

findings.issue: Only null triggers NotFound; a non-404 API error (500, network down) renders neither the page nor an error state — no ErrorBoundary anywhere.
findings.suggestion: Add an ErrorBoundary and a test that a failing getPokemon renders a fallback instead of a blank main.

findings.issue: In-memory cache (60 s TTL, promise dedupe, error eviction) and the MAX_CONCURRENT=24 FIFO limiter are untested; a deadlock or stale-error bug would only surface under production load.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test with a mocked fetch: concurrent same-URL requests share one fetch, 404 rejects with NotFoundError and evicts, more than 24 parallel requests queue and all resolve.

findings.issue: shortEffect substitutes $effect_chance with '' when effect_chance is null, which can leave a dangling '%' in rendered effect text.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test shortEffect for null effect_chance, missing short_effect falling back to flavor text, and cleanText whitespace collapsing.

findings.issue: humanize/dexNumber/display are trivial-looking but encode spec rules (Mr Mime, #0025, em dash) that every page depends on.
findings.suggestion: A handful of one-line unit tests here is the cheapest regression insurance in the repo.

summary: The app ships zero tests: no runner, no script, no spec files. The data layer (filtering, pagination, move grouping, card deduping) and the hand-rolled URL/debounce sync in the home route are exactly the code a future refactor would break silently. Until tests exist, every change to app/src/lib/server/model.ts is flying on the acceptance suite alone.
